title: Lockheed gets $72.6M to speed up delayed F-35 Block 4 upgrade
big: 13 new stories since the last brief. The busiest areas: adversaries: china, russia, iran and missiles, hypersonics & munitions.

stories.h: Lockheed gets $72.6M to speed up delayed F-35 Block 4 upgrade
stories.what: The U.S. Navy has added $72.6 million in scope to a Lockheed Martin F-35 development contract to “accelerate the development of F-35 Lightning II Block 4 capabilities,” according to a Department of War contract announcement.
stories.you: Lockheed Martin books $72.6 million for F-35. Count it as demand, and watch whether the next order is a follow-on or a one-off.

stories.h: Under $200,000 per missile: U.S. Army’s target for Stinger successor
stories.what: The U.S. Army is looking for a third contender to replace the Stinger missile. On Nov. 20, it asked industry for a ready-made “alternate interceptor” under its Next Generation Short Range Interceptor program, with a live-fire shootout planned for mid-2027.

stories.h: Hegseth memo limits U.S.-Canada defense ties, report says
stories.what: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth has ordered new limits on how the U.S. military works with Canada, in a classified memo circulated last week, officials familiar with the directive said, according to a report published Friday.

stories.h: Europeans, with Ukraine’s help, brace for more Russian attacks
stories.what: IZMIR, Turkey— Vladimir Putin would “love to end the war,” as Donald Trump asserted on Friday, but European NATO members and Ukrainians are working to make sure Russia’s invasion of Ukraine doesn’t end on Moscow’s terms.

stories.h: Putin’s National Guard division near Moscow gets heavy armor
stories.what: Russia’s National Guard, a force that answers directly to Vladimir Putin, has handed tanks to its best-known division outside Moscow.
